BEHAVIORAL_GAP_DIAGNOSIS (bot-psychologist, 2026-05-12):
primary_gap_type: guidance_gap
affected_files: reviewer-base.md + REVIEW-WORKFLOW.md

Gap 1 — reachability caller-input verification: reachability field allows narrative path without requiring grep of call sites to verify claimed inputs are actually produced. Fix: add 'Caller-input verification gate' sub-rule requiring grep of all call sites before asserting any input claim.

Gap 2 — arithmetic claim verification: no requirement to compute path/index arithmetic step-by-step before asserting. Fix: add 'Arithmetic verification gate' sub-rule.

Gap 3 — tautology simulation: test-coupling criterion says check inverted conditional but does not require tracing mock setup + assertion chain. Fix: add simulation requirement before claiming tautology.

Gap 4 — critical inflation on unverified claims: IMPORTANT vs CRITICAL distinction doesn't cover confident-but-wrong claims from unverified inputs. Fix: add rule that unverified quantitative/caller-input claims must not be 'critical'.

Gap 5 — defense records in local cycle-N: CI runner uses two-call architecture + suppress_defended_findings, but REVIEW-WORKFLOW.md re-review dispatch passes NO defense context. Fix: inject prior defenses as === PRIOR DEFENSES === block when ATTEMPT_NUM >= 2.

testing_mode: UPDATE
proposed_files: plugins/dso/docs/workflows/prompts/reviewer-base.md, plugins/dso/docs/workflows/REVIEW-WORKFLOW.md
